name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly transferred into bank accounts of all landholding farmer families across India.
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefitSummary: ₹6,000 per year direct income support (DBT in 3 installments)

all.label: Occupation is Farmer or Tenant Farmer
Must hold cultivable land

source.name: API Setu / PM-KISAN Portal
source.note: Verified via Ministry of Agriculture DBT API Setu specification

officialDocumentText:
PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN) OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES.
1. Objective: To augment the income of all landholding farmers' families in the country to procure various inputs related to agriculture and domestic needs.
2. Eligibility Criteria: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names are eligible. The definition of family comprises husband, wife, and minor children.
3. Financial Benefit: Under the scheme, financial assistance of Rs. 6000/- per annum is provided to eligible beneficiary farmer families in three four-monthly installments of Rs. 2000/- each through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
4. Required Documents & Identifiers: Aadhaar Card (mandatory for e-KYC), Land Holding Ownership Records (7/12 extract / Khasra / Khatauni), Bank Passbook with active IFSC code and Aadhaar linkage.
5. Exclusion Criteria: Institutional landholders, constitutional post holders, serving/retired government employees, professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CA), and individuals who paid income tax in the last assessment year are excluded.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (Crop Insurance Scheme)
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against non-preventable natural risks, crop damage, post-harvest losses, and unseasonal rains with nominal premium rates.
department: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers Welfare
benefitSummary: Comprehensive risk insurance covering up to 100% sum insured for crop loss

all.label: Occupation is Farmer or Tenant Farmer
Must cultivate notified crops on agricultural land

source.name: API Setu / PMFBY Portal
source.note: Integrated with Samrakshane and State Crop Insurance Portals via API Setu

officialDocumentText:
PRADHAN MANTRI FASAL BIMA YOJANA (PMFBY) REVISED OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES.
1. Scheme Overview: PMFBY aims to provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising out of unforeseen natural events.
2. Eligible Farmers: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas including sharecroppers and tenant farmers are eligible.
3. Premium Structure: Maximum premium payable by farmers is 2% for all Kharif food & oilseed crops, 1.5% for all Rabi crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops. The rest of the actuarial premium is subsidized equally by Central and State Governments.
4. Coverage of Risks: Comprehensive coverage for Prevented Sowing/Planting Risk, Standing Crop loss (mid-season adversity due to floods, drought, pest attack), Post-Harvest Losses (up to 14 days after harvesting), and Localized Calamities (hailstorm, landslide, inundation).
5. Claim Settlement: Assessed through Crop Cutting Experiments (CCEs) and remote sensing technology, with direct credit into farmer bank accounts.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme & Interest Subvention
description: Provides timely and adequate credit to farmers from the banking system for agricultural operations, purchase of seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, machinery, and allied activities at subsidized interest rates.
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / RBI / NABARD
benefitSummary: Credit limit up to ₹3,00,000 at 4% effective interest rate with prompt repayment

all.label: Engaged in agriculture or allied rural activities
Applicant aged 18 years or above
Applicant aged 75 years or below

source.name: myScheme / API Setu
source.note: Kisan Credit Card guidelines via Ministry of Agriculture and RBI

officialDocumentText:
KISAN CREDIT CARD (KCC) SCHEME GUIDELINES.
1. Objective: To meet the short term credit requirements for cultivation of crops, post-harvest expenses, produce marketing loan, consumption requirements of farmer household, and working capital for maintenance of farm assets and activities allied to agriculture.
2. Eligibility: All individual farmers/joint borrowers who are owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees & share croppers, and SHGs or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers.
3. Interest Rate & Subvention: Benchmark interest rate is 7% per annum. An Interest Subvention Scheme (ISS) of 3% is provided for prompt repayment, making the effective interest rate only 4% per annum for loans up to Rs. 3,00,000.
4. Collateral Security: Waived for KCC loans up to Rs. 1.60 Lakh without collateral (raised up to Rs. 3.00 Lakh for tie-up arrangements).
5. Validity & Renewal: Card is valid for 5 years subject to annual review and renewal based on repayment.

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop (Micro-Irrigation)
description: Financial assistance and subsidy for installing precision micro-irrigation systems (Drip and Sprinkler irrigation) to improve water use efficiency, crop yield, and farm productivity.
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture
benefitSummary: Up to 55% financial subsidy on drip and sprinkler irrigation installations

all.label: Occupation is Farmer
Owns or leases agricultural land suitable for micro-irrigation

source.name: PMKSY National Portal
source.note: Operational Guidelines for Per Drop More Crop (PDMC)

officialDocumentText:
PRADHAN MANTRI KRISHI SINCHAYEE YOJANA (PMKSY) - PER DROP MORE CROP (PDMC).
1. Focus: Enhancing water use efficiency at farm level through Micro Irrigation technologies like Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation systems.
2. Subsidy Pattern: Financial assistance is provided at 55% of the indicative system cost for Small & Marginal farmers (holding up to 2 hectares), and 45% for Other farmers (holding more than 2 hectares). Additional top-up subsidies are provided by several state governments (e.g. MahaDBT in Maharashtra).
3. Eligible Beneficiaries: All categories of farmers are eligible. Farmers who have valid land ownership documents or registered lease agreements for at least 7 years are eligible to install micro-irrigation equipment.
4. Required Documents: Aadhaar Card, 7/12 Land Record / Land Title, Electricity Bill / Water Source verification, Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar.
5. Expected Impact: Water savings of 30-50%, fertilizer savings of 25-40% through fertigation, and crop yield enhancement of 20-40%.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
description: Provides 40% to 50% financial subsidy on purchase of modern agricultural machinery (tractors, rotavators, power tillers, seed drills, laser levelers) to reduce drudgery and increase crop production efficiency.
department: Mechanization & Technology Division, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefitSummary: 40% to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹1,25,000) on farm machinery and tractors

all.label: Occupation is Farmer
Applicant must hold cultivable agricultural land

source.name: Direct Benefit Transfer in Agriculture Mechanization

officialDocumentText:
SUB-MISSION ON AGRICULTURAL MECHANIZATION (SMAM) GUIDELINES.
1. Objectives: Increasing the reach of farm mechanization to small and marginal farmers and to regions where availability of farm power is low.
2. Subsidy Pattern: Up to 50% financial assistance for procurement of agricultural equipment for Small & Marginal Farmers, SC/ST, and Women Farmers. Up to 40% subsidy for other general category farmers.
3. Eligible Machinery: Tractors, Power Tillers, Multicrop Threshers, Rotavators, Super Seeders, Zero Till Seed Cum Fertilizer Drills, Laser Land Levelers, Harvesters, and Solar Powered Sprayers.
4. Eligibility: Farmers who have not availed subsidy for the same equipment within the last 5 to 7 years.
5. Application Process: Registration on Agrimachinery portal (agrimachinery.nic.in) or State DBT portals (like MahaDBT), uploading Aadhaar, Land records (7/12 & 8A), Bank Passbook, Caste Certificate (if applicable), and quotation from authorized dealers.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY Pension)
description: An assured old age pension scheme providing ₹3,000 per month (₹36,000 per year) to small and marginal farmers upon attaining 60 years of age.
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare in partnership with LIC of India
benefitSummary: ₹36,000 per year (₹3,000/month) lifelong pension after age 60

all.label: Small and Marginal Farmer
Land holding up to 2 hectares (Small & Marginal)
Must possess cultivable land
Entry age minimum 18 years
Entry age maximum 40 years

officialDocumentText:
PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN MAANDHAN YOJANA (PM-KMY) OPERATIONAL DETAILS.
1. Scheme Nature: PM-KMY is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme for Small and Marginal Farmers (SMFs) to provide them social security during old age.
2. Eligibility: Small and Marginal Farmers having cultivable land up to 2 hectares as per land records of the concerned State/UT, aged between 18 to 40 years.
3. Monthly Contribution: Monthly subscription ranging between Rs. 55 to Rs. 200 per month depending upon entry age. The Central Government makes an equal 50% matching contribution into the Pension Fund managed by LIC.
4. Pension Benefit: Upon attaining the age of 60 years, the beneficiary receives an assured monthly pension of Rs. 3,000/- directly into their bank account.
5. Spouse Benefits: On death of the pensioner, the spouse is entitled to receive 50% of the pension as family pension provided the spouse is not already an SMF beneficiary of the scheme.

name: Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Pariyojana (MKSP)
description: Dedicated empowerment program for women in agriculture to improve their participation, productivity, and sustainable organic livelihood income.
department: Ministry of Rural Development & Ministry of Agriculture
benefitSummary: ₹12,000 annual capacity building, input support & direct livelihood assistance

all.label: Applicant must be a woman farmer / agricultural worker
Aged 18 years or above
Engaged in agriculture, dairy, or rural allied work

officialDocumentText:
MAHILA KISAN SASHAKTIKARAN PARIYOJANA (MKSP) GUIDELINES.
1. Objective: MKSP, as a sub-component of DAY-NRLM, seeks to improve the present status of women in agriculture and to enhance the opportunities for their empowerment.
2. Target Group: Women farmers, women agricultural labourers, smallholders, and self-help group (SHG) members engaged in sustainable agro-ecological practices, livestock rearing, non-timber forest produce, and organic cluster development.
3. Benefits Provided: Skill development training in sustainable agriculture, financial assistance for farm inputs and bio-resource centers, credit facilitation through SHGs, access to customized drudgery-reduction tools, and direct market linkage.
4. Required Documentation: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, and self-declaration / SHG membership certificate.
5. Implementing Agencies: State Rural Livelihood Missions (SRLM) and Community Resource Persons (Krishi Sakhis).

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (Organic Farming Promotion)
description: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic farming clusters, PGS certification, organic seeds, bio-fertilizers, and value addition.
department: Integrated Nutrient Management Division, Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefitSummary: ₹50,000 per hectare (over 3 years) for organic farming inputs and PGS certification

all.label: Occupation is Farmer or Tenant Farmer
Must hold cultivable land for organic cluster adoption

source.name: PGS India / National Center of Organic Farming

officialDocumentText:
PARAMPARAGAT KRISHI VIKAS YOJANA (PKVY) REVISED SCHEME GUIDELINES.
1. Objective: To promote organic farming among rural youth, farmers, and consumers through cluster approach and Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) certification.
2. Financial Assistance: Financial assistance of Rs. 50,000 per hectare is provided for 3 years. Out of this, Rs. 31,000/ha (62%) is directly provided to farmers via DBT for organic inputs (seeds, bio-fertilizers, vermicompost, botanical extracts), and Rs. 8,800/ha is provided for value addition, packaging, and marketing support.
3. Implementation Model: Organic farming is promoted through clusters of 20 hectares or 50 farmers. Farmers receive free PGS-India certification without fees.
4. Eligibility: Any farmer possessing cultivable land willing to commit to chemical-free organic farming practices.
5. Required Documents: Aadhaar Card, 7/12 Land Record / Khasra, Bank Account Details with IFSC code.
